item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President prospectively directs the establishment of an advisory committee, chaired by the Secretary of Commerce, whose object is to guide the Export-Import Bank's board; this is internal executive organization and creates no substantive legal consequence for outside parties.","evidence":"I will establish an Export Expansion Advisory Committee."},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President describes prior requests and actions, then urges Congress to enact pending fiscal and legislative measures; any legal consequence would occur through future congressional action, not through this segment.","evidence":"I urge the Congress to take prompt action on these requests."},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The President makes a hortatory appeal for Congress to act, without directing an agency or itself changing any legal right, duty, status, or funding.","evidence":"I call upon the Congress to act--now."}]}
